messages:
devin (oncall): heads-up: we're seeing increased 5xxs and elevated p99 on text-gen + embeddings in us-west since 15:12 PDT. Ticket INC-2026-04-15-47. Need coordinated customer comms and decision on webinar status.
sara (Marcom): thanks. Quick Q: are dedicated/private customers impacted or just hosted?
devin (oncall): hosted only. Dedicated pools unaffected; a couple private deployments on older runtime versions unaffected.
pat (Support): already getting a few premium accounts pinging our inbox. Can we give support a clear canned line and confirm escalation path?
sara (Marcom): propose immediate statuspage stub "Investigating" with very short bullets, then enterprise email if not resolved in 30-45m. Also: we have a scheduled webinar in 40m targeted at EU/APAC — do we postpone or proceed?
rahul (Sales): For the webinar, best to postpone if live demos rely on hosted endpoints. If it's slides-only, we can proceed but add a short note at start. Sales prefers postpone to avoid demo failures.
devin (oncall): mitigation attempts ongoing; if rollback helps we'll have improvement in ~10-15m.
sara (Marcom): draft statuspage text: "Investigating — intermittent errors and increased response times for Redwood hosted API in us-west. Engineers are working on fixes; we will update every 20 minutes." Keep it short and non-technical. Thoughts?
pat (Support): good. Add a single sentence for support snippet: "We're investigating intermittent errors in us-west for hosted API. Live updates: <statuspage.link>. If you need immediate relief, try routing requests to another region or reduce concurrency."
rahul (Sales): please include "Dedicated/private unaffected" in any customer-facing line. That's key for enterprise peace-of-mind.
sara (Marcom): added. Also prepping a short tweet + LinkedIn line: "We’re investigating intermittent API errors in US-West; hosted customers may see retries. Private & Dedicated unaffected. Live updates: <statuspage.link>." OK?
devin (oncall): ok to publish statuspage now. timeline: publish at 15:18 PDT, check 15:38 for update. If no fix, then escalate to broader email.
pat (Support): I’ll prep canned snippets and a prioritized account list to notify if needed.
localization-bot: prepping translations EN->FR/DE/JP/ES for statuspage and enterprise note; ETA 25m.
sara (Marcom): decision on webinar: Rahul, can you confirm whether demos use hosted endpoints?
rahul (Sales): confirmed demos use hosted inference. Recommend postpone. I'll notify registrants with a brief note and reschedule link.
sara (Marcom): draft registrant message: "We’re pausing today’s live demo due to an ongoing service issue with our hosted API in US-West. We’ll reschedule shortly; apologies for the interruption." Keep tone apologetic + practical.
pat (Support): Approved. Also add link to product docs for customers who want to pin regions or self-host.
devin (oncall): 15:33 PDT update: rollback to previous routing config reduced errors by ~70%. Monitoring. Recommend hold on enterprise email until fully stable.
sara (Marcom): holding email. Will draft post-incident communication now (root cause + guidance + links to docs and webinar reschedule).
pat (Support): once post-incident draft is ready, send to me and I'll plug into helpdesk macros.
localization-bot: translations queued (15:38 PDT).
devin (oncall): 15:45 PDT: moved to monitoring, errors near baseline. Planning to close INC in 30m if stable.
sara (Marcom): draft post-incident public copy: "Resolved — We experienced intermittent errors and elevated latency in US-West affecting hosted API. A rollback to our routing layer mitigated the issue. No customer data loss; Dedicated and Private deployments were not impacted. We’ve published technical notes and recommendations for routing and retry strategies." Any edits?
rahul (Sales): add a line: "If your workflows rely on a single region, consider configuring multi-region fallbacks."
sara (Marcom): added. Plan: publish post-incident at T+45 and send an enterprise email at T+60 with tailored guidance and webinar reschedule link.
pat (Support): approved. I’ll update canned replies and notify affected accounts.
devin (oncall): closing notes: will include timeline + root cause for post-mortem. Keep this channel for any inbound customer spikes.
sara (Marcom): thanks team. I'll post the final messages and the reschedule for the webinar.
